widgets_values:
# YuE2 song

Three paths: fresh planning from lyrics and style, SheetSage2 transcription of reference audio used as-is, or that transcription extended by the planner.

Lyrics and style → Planning → ABC → Acoustic → ABC + FLAC.

**ABC** now shows the selected score as sheet music beside its highlighted source. Click a note in either view to find it in the other; Expand opens a larger view. This is the exact score used for audio generation and saved with the FLAC.

Optional preview playback plays fixed-velocity notes so you can hear what the ABC says; the song itself comes from Acoustic. See the soundfont note below the ABC node.

Drop reference audio onto the loader at top left, or use its upload button. The Use transcription and Extend transcribed ABC switches sit just below it, above lyrics and style; models sit below Planning. Controls on the Planning face feed fresh planning and extension together. Acoustic controls are independent. max_duration is an upper limit.

Optional external ABC → MIDI conversion: [Symusic](https://github.com/Yikai-Liao/symusic). It is not a dependency.

**Use transcription** turns the reference-audio branch on and off from the main canvas. Off bypasses the branch, so SheetSage2 and reference-audio files are not validated or loaded. **Extend transcribed ABC** continues the transcription through the planner. The template uses standard ComfyUI audio and encoder loaders.

nodes.title: ABC · sheet music, source, preview playback

widgets_values:
## Preview playback needs your own soundfont

Download a General MIDI `.sf2` yourself, for example [GeneralUser GS](https://github.com/mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS). Put it in `ComfyUI/models/soundfonts/`, refresh the browser, and choose it on the ABC node.

Without one, sheet music and source still work; only playback is off.
